cornerstone.holders: GIC, Fidelity International, BlackRock, Mercedes-Benz AG, Oaktree, Golden Link, Franklin Templeton, Boyu, Gaoyi Entities, CPIC, GF Fund, ChinaAMC (HK), Suzhou Mosu, GigaDevice
cornerstone.full_quote: RESTRICTIONS ON THE CORNERSTONE INVESTORS Each of the Cornerstone Investors has agreed that it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of six months from and including the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), dispose of any of the Offer Shares each has purchased pursuant to the relevant Cornerstone Investment Agreement, save for certain limited circumstances, such as any transfer to any of its wholly-owned subsidiaries which will be bound by the same obligations of such Cornerstone Investor (including the relevant restriction during the Lock-up Period).
cornerstone.basis: six calendar months from and including the Listing Date (duration wording with inclusive start); frees up on the six-month anniversary of the Listing Date

controller_6m.full_quote: (B) Undertakings by the Controlling Shareholders to the Stock Exchange pursuant to the Listing Rules Pursuant to Rule 10.07 of the Listing Rules, each of the Controlling Shareholders has undertaken to the Stock Exchange and the Company that, save as disclosed in the Prospectus and except pursuant to the Global Offering, it will not and will procure that the relevant registered holder(s) will not: (1) in the period commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of its holding of Shares is made in this prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date (the “Six-Month Period”), dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the Shares in respect of which it is shown by this prospectus to be the beneficial owner; or
controller_6m.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(a): period commencing on the prospectus disclosure date and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date (the 'Six-Month Period'); inclusive end date, so the first free day is the day after the six-month anniversary

controller_12m.full_quote: (2) in the period of six months commencing from the expiry of the Six-Month Period, dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any such Shares referred to in (1) above if, immediately following such disposal, or upon the exercise or enforcement of such options, rights, interests or encumbrances, any of them would cease to be a Controlling Shareholder or a member of the group of Controlling Shareholders, or together with the other Controlling Shareholders would cease to be a group of Controlling Shareholders.
controller_12m.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(b): six-month period commencing from expiry of the Six-Month Period, i.e. running to 12 months from the Listing Date, conditional on ceasing to be a Controlling Shareholder / the group of Controlling Shareholders; first free day is the day after the 12-month anniversary
controller_12m.notes: Separately, '(E) Undertakings by all of our Shareholders as of the date of this Prospectus pursuant to Lock-up Undertakings' (p303) lock up all shareholders for 'the period that shall commence from (and be inclusive of) the Listing Date and shall end on (and be inclusive of) the date that is six months from the Listing Date'.
